## Core

Make personal video communication effortless.

$36/user/month

Billed annually • **Save 14%**

[Buy now](https://login.bombbomb.com/signup-auth0?flow=buy&plan=Core&cadence=yearly)

### Core includes:

- Unlimited video recording and sending
- Real-time alerts showing who watched, when and how much
- Record and send from iOS and Android apps, Chrome, Edge, Gmail and Outlook
- Custom branding, animated or custom thumbnails, and video CTAs
- Automatic captions and transcripts on every video
- A shared video library for everyone on your account
- Secure video hosting (SOC 2 Type II)

## Frequently asked questions

How much does BombBomb cost?

Core is $36 and Pro is $56 per user, per month when billed annually, or $42 and $70 if you pay monthly. Enterprise pricing is custom, so we’ll build it around your team.

What’s the difference between Core and Pro?

Core covers personal video: record it, brand it, send it, and see who watched. Pro adds tools to do more with every relationship, including team video campaigns, email campaigns, contact management, integrations and reporting.

Is there a free trial?

Yes, you can try BombBomb for 14 days. A credit card is required to start, and your trial continues into a paid plan unless you cancel before it ends.

Can I pay monthly instead of annually?

Yes. Core and Pro can be billed monthly or annually. Annual billing saves you $72 per user, per year on Core and $168 on Pro. Annual plans are a 12-month commitment.

Will BombBomb work with the tools I already use?

BombBomb fits right into the tools you already use. On any plan, you can record and send from your phone or desktop, right inside Gmail, Outlook, Chrome and Edge. Pro connects with tools like Salesforce, HubSpot, Total Expert, Outreach and Zendesk.

Can I use BombBomb on my phone?

Absolutely! Mobile is a great way to record and send videos from any app and anywhere. Every plan includes our iOS and Android apps, so you can see when your videos are watched and keep buyers confident along the way.

When does Enterprise make sense?

Enterprise is for organizations that need extra support and control, like dedicated onboarding, SSO provisioning or using your own cloud storage. Talk to our team and we’ll help you figure out if it’s the right fit.

Can I change or cancel my plan later?

Yes. You can cancel anytime from your account settings, and your plan stays active through the end of the billing period you’ve paid for.

How is BombBomb different from Loom or Vidyard?

Like Loom and Vidyard, BombBomb makes it easy to record and share videos. But we believe real trust comes from real people. With personalized videos, contact management, email campaigns, and engagement insights, BombBomb helps you build buyer confidence at every step of the journey.
